post.summary: Issue a bounded management session for a current owner
post.description: Private operator plane, secured by deployment unreachability. Does not grant ownership. Request UUID is the idempotency key; expired or revoked requests require a new explicit request. The credential is returned only in this response and must not be logged.

201.description: Created; token, expiresAt (epoch seconds), sessionId, requestId, outcome

200.description: Existing current idempotent session; same claims and credential

403.description: Current owner, tenant, phase or credential refused

409.description: Idempotency conflict, expired request or current signing-key mismatch
